items.question: Which portion of an offering must a woman dedicate, leaving the remainder?
premises: The term ṣaṣṭhī specifies a sixth portion.
The verb samutsṛjet prescribes that this portion be offered.
The subject strī identifies the woman as the agent of the offering.
The term śeṣaḥ denotes what remains after that portion is given.
items.inference: A woman is enjoined to offer a sixth portion, with the rest remaining as the remainder.
uncertainties: The exact substance or context of the offering is supplied by the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: A woman should offer a sixth part; thus the remainder is left.
